item.description: Endpoints for retrieving the possible metadata values which can be assigned to IconDB assets or which can be used to search IconDB.

item.name: Asset Retrieval

request.description:
The primary endpoint for retrieving metadata and assets. Generally the values for the parameters are all optional, and the default behavior of the endpoint is to serve only the metadata absent parameters indicating otherwise.

The values for the parameters generally come from the values you find under the `Meta` folder in this collection. However, certain values represent database ids which can be found in the metadata json which is returned by this endpoint.

Note that this endpoint will only return assets in `LifeCycleState = Released`.

response.name: Assets

item.description: Endpoints for retrieving IconDB assets and associated metadata about those assets.

item.name: Authentication

request.description: Endpoint for generating a Bearer Token which is used in subsequent requests to the endpoints in this collection. The username must be a valid P&G user account, and the user must have an active account within IconDB.

item.description: Endpoints for authenticating to the IconDB API.
